cases.name: issue2110_tangent_cylinders_union_a135_b225
cases.note: #2110: the union of a cylinder R 10 along x through (y, z) = (0, -10), x -20..20, and one R 5 along y through (x, z) = (0, -5), y -20..20, which touch inside at the origin; each SmApiCreateCylinder turned about Z for its seam (A 135 deg, B 225 deg), onto its axis and moved, as crates/solidcore/tests/issue_2110_tangent_cylinders_union.rs builds them. At the default fixes (upstream behaviour, the SSI marcher steps through the node without splitting its curves, WR-77) the result fails SMLib's check (SmFace #29 Face crosses Seam, SmEdgeuse #7 Bad UVTrimCurve), as #2110 reports. Compares the union's status and its result's counts only: the pinned C++ crashes (SIGSEGV) checking this result, so it is not a `checked` case; the Rust check's #29 / #7 failures are pinned by the regression test.
